# Sample size calculation for two-sample t-test
# Comparing two independent normal means with equal variances, 1:1 allocation
# One-sided pooled t-test at alpha = 0.05, target power = 0.8

library(stats)

# Input parameters
effect_diff <- 4.3        # Expected difference (dBA)
common_sd <- 7.8          # Common standard deviation (dBA)
alpha <- 0.05             # Significance level
target_power <- 0.80      # Target power
allocation_ratio <- 1     # 1:1 allocation

# Calculate standardized effect size (Cohen's d)
cohens_d <- effect_diff / common_sd
cat("Standardized effect size (Cohen's d):", cohens_d, "\n")

# For one-sided test: divide alpha by 2 to get critical value for upper tail
# Critical z value
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # One-sided critical value at alpha=0.05
z_beta <- qnorm(target_power)   # Critical z for power

cat("Critical z (alpha=0.05, one-sided):", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("Critical z (power=0.80):", z_beta, "\n")

# Sample size formula for one-sided t-test (using normal approximation)
# n = (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * 2 * sigma^2 / delta^2
# For equal variances and 1:1 allocation:
n_continuous <- ((z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * (common_sd^2 + common_sd^2)) / effect_diff^2

cat("\nContinuous solution (per group):", n_continuous, "\n")

# Round up to nearest integer to ensure power target is met
n_per_group <- ceiling(n_continuous)
cat("Rounded sample size (per group):", n_per_group, "\n")

# Verify achieved power at the selected design
# Using non-central t distribution
df <- 2 * n_per_group - 2  # Degrees of freedom for two-sample t-test
ncp <- effect_diff / sqrt(2 * common_sd^2 / n_per_group)  # Non-centrality parameter

# Critical t value (one-sided, alpha=0.05)
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha/2, df)

# Achieved power (probability that t > t_crit under alternative)
achieved_power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp=ncp)

cat("\nVerification at selected design:\n")
cat("Degrees of freedom:", df, "\n")
cat("Non-centrality parameter:", ncp, "\n")
cat("Critical t value (one-sided, alpha=0.05):", t_crit, "\n")
cat("Achieved power at n =", n_per_group, ":", achieved_power, "\n")

# Check power at preceding admissible design (n-1)
if (n_per_group > 1) {
  n_prev <- n_per_group - 1
  df_prev <- 2 * n_prev - 2
  ncp_prev <- effect_diff / sqrt(2 * common_sd^2 / n_prev)
  t_crit_prev <- qt(1 - alpha/2, df_prev)
  power_prev <- 1 - pt(t_crit_prev, df_prev, ncp=ncp_prev)
  
  cat("\nVerification at preceding design (n =", n_prev, "):\n")
  cat("Degrees of freedom:", df_prev, "\n")
  cat("Non-centrality parameter:", ncp_prev, "\n")
  cat("Critical t value:", t_crit_prev, "\n")
  cat("Power at n =", n_prev, ":", power_prev, "\n")
}

# Summary output
cat("\n========== RESULTS ==========\n")
cat("Minimum integer sample size per group:", n_per_group, "\n")
cat("Total sample size (both groups):", 2 * n_per_group, "\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(achieved_power, 4), "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("Power criterion satisfied:", achieved_power >= target_power, "\n")

# Find exact minimum sample size meeting 80% power criterion
# by incremental search upward

effect_diff <- 4.3
common_sd <- 7.8
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80

# Function to compute achieved power for a given n per group
compute_power <- function(n_per_group, effect_diff, common_sd, alpha) {
  df <- 2 * n_per_group - 2
  ncp <- effect_diff / sqrt(2 * common_sd^2 / n_per_group)
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha/2, df)
  power <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp=ncp)
  return(power)
}

# Start from n=52 and search upward
for (n in 52:60) {
  power <- compute_power(n, effect_diff, common_sd, alpha)
  meets_target <- power >= target_power
  cat(sprintf("n = %2d: power = %.6f, meets 80%% target: %s\n", n, power, meets_target))
  
  if (meets_target) {
    n_selected <- n
    power_selected <- power
    break
  }
}

# Also verify preceding design
n_preceding <- n_selected - 1
power_preceding <- compute_power(n_preceding, effect_diff, common_sd, alpha)

cat("\n========== FINAL RESULT ==========\n")
cat("Minimum sample size per group:", n_selected, "\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(power_selected, 6), "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("\nPreceding design (n =", n_preceding, "):\n")
cat("Power:", round(power_preceding, 6), "\n")

# Output in POWER_AGENT_RESULT format
results <- list(
  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_selected,
  unit = "participants_per_group"
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", jsonlite::toJSON(
  list(
    results = list(results),
    simulation = NULL
  ),
  auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15
), sep = "")
